summary.text: Bridget Plouffe is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 9th Plymouth District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She previously worked as a legislative aide and chief of staff in the Legislature.

paragraphs.text: Plouffe graduated from Fontbonne Academy and earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from Providence College in 2015.

Her career experience includes working for Brockton Public Schools, as legislative aide and chief of staff to state Representative Gerry Cassidy, and as chief of staff for the Joint Committee on Veterans and Federal Affairs.
Plouffe assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Cassidy.

For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Human Resources and Employee Engagement Committee and the Joint Committees on Cannabis Policy, Education, Public Safety and Homeland Security, and Revenue.
